plugins.prepareCmd: test -n "$IMAGE_DIGEST" && test "$IMAGE_VERSION" = "${nextRelease.version}" && sed -i -E 's|^version: .*|version: ${nextRelease.version}|' chart/Chart.yaml && sed -i -E 's|^appVersion: .*|appVersion: "${nextRelease.version}"|' chart/Chart.yaml && sed -i -E '/^image:/,/^[a-zA-Z]/ s|^([[:space:]]+)tag: .*|\1tag: "${nextRelease.version}@'"$IMAGE_DIGEST"'"|' chart/values.yaml
